pages.text: $(4)$(l)Spoiler!$()$(br2)This entry gives away a puzzle solution. Turn the page only if you want to see it.
$(l)Thaumatoriums need a heat source$() underneath; without one, essentia won't go in.
$(l)Infusion seals$() come from defeating the 3rd Shell bosses; check their structures for the required items (e.g., 8 clunkheads).

$(l)Rune Templars$() spawn in underground Runic Brick structures around Y=5. Use a Catalytic Lens, Void Tear, and Air Sigil to clear them efficiently. Right-click with the matching colored rune to change its color, then kill it for a colored chunk.

Quest rewards from Chapter 5 onward (e.g., realmstone quests) include scanner modules that help locate Rune Templar structures—standard Scanner mod tools won’t detect them due to nonstandard generation.
Never detonate seals (e.g., ODB or Draconian reactor explosions) near your base—they destroy structures and items. Build them in a remote area.
The Runandor puzzle solution appears in JEI, but requires eight runes found in the dimension. The liquid elecanium tank is $(o)not$() shown in JEI or tooltips and must be discovered separately.
